record.title: MEASURE R75-R76 immutable learning
record.body: Durable novel learning: attributable event-level throughput is insufficient without a complete portfolio production topology. Compose exact schedule attribution with repository exact-subject census and ExistingStructure->DesiredStructure->Ontology->Pack/Composition->Generator->Artifact->Consumer->Qualification->Standing. Falling T with an open displacement frontier is a constraint observation. High T with low G is observable structural debt. Generalizable downstream verifier failure must become upstream repair and requalification, as demonstrated by the inherited R34 missing-RDF dependency discovered by R76. Dual RevenueFROMCustomer and RevenueFORCustomer must remain semantically distinct until independently evidenced.
